ui-provider-catalogue-empty: No Provider release is available in the configured repositories.
ui-operation-empty: Choose an operation to view its progress.
ui-operation-pending-hint: The request is accepted. Completion has not been confirmed yet.
ui-operation-completed-hint: The server confirms that the upgrade is completed.
ui-operation-failed-hint: The operation failed. Review its details before trying again.
ui-operation-follow-up-hint: This step finished, but the upgrade is not marked completed. Review its technical state.
ui-operation-manual-hint: The operation is still pending. Automatic checks have stopped; refresh its status when needed.
ui-operation-retry-hint: The current state could not be read. Refresh to check it again.
ui-upgrade-select-release: Choose an exact release from the Provider list to review an upgrade.
ui-operation-start-retry: Review the form feedback before trying again. No completion has been confirmed.
ui-operation-reconnecting-hint: Checking again shortly. Completion is not confirmed.
ui-operation-cancelled-hint: The server confirms that the upgrade was cancelled.
